title: a chance/null/comprehension-free reference
claim: an explicit chance or null reference for a reported result.
present: an explicit chance or null baseline for at least one reported result ("random baseline: 25%", "majority-class: 51%", "chance level shown in table")
absent: comparisons to other models only (a rival model is a comparator, not a null)
"significantly above chance" with no stated chance value MAY be `unclear` - see §3
